apps/web/components/molecules/settings/S.empty: A row is one setting with a required title; it renders no collection. A row without a description or control is the Default story with fewer props, not an empty state.
apps/web/components/molecules/settings/S.error: The row owns no data or request, so it has no failure of its own. A page that cannot load a setting passes its message as the description, as the Sessions unavailable row does in SessionManagementCard.test.tsx.
apps/web/components/molecules/settings/S.partial: The row renders its title, description and control together from props; it never loads in parts.

apps/web/components/organisms/SettingsSi.partial: The rail is built from the static settings navigation config, so its groups and items arrive together; only the Profile label waits on the artist name, which falls back to Profile and is covered by LongContentArtistName.
apps/web/components/organisms/SettingsSi.permission-denied: Every signed-in account sees the same settings destinations; the one optional item (Payments) is a release flag, not a permission, and the rail never shows a denied destination.
